Indel Signature InsDel_C

InsDel_C

Note

InsDel_C looks somewhat similar to InsDel_13 in prominence of deletions of Ts that are followed by A. However, the 83-type and 476-type classifications show that InsDel13 has deletions of 2 Ts while InsDel_C has deletions of 1 T.

Nevertheless, InsDel13 and InsDel_C were extracted separately, possibly because of the insertion of isolated Ts in InsDel13 but not InsDel_C

(corresponds to 83-type signature ID_C )

WARNING: The 83-type ID_C extraction seems to have excluded T deletions and insertions in most contexts, leaving only isolated T deletions (nonT)T(nonT) -> (nonT)(nonT). The other T deletions and insertions were detected in extractions in the 89-type and 476-type classifications. This proportion was 10% for InsDel_K_alpha and approximately 17% for InsDel_K_beta.
